verdict.rationale: Shortwave's first-party docs describe adding any MCP server through an "Add custom integration" button, which lets the AI Assistant use that server's tools. The pricing page confirms MCP alongside the built-in integrations, and named examples such as GitHub and Zapier show tool use inside the inbox. Missing for 10: in-depth setup documentation (supported transports, auth handling, tool permission controls) and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom MCP servers work as claimed.
